div.div:
pattern is one of: weekly (chosen days of the week), monthly (a day of the month), daily.
Assumptions :
A1. Availability is cut into bookable slots of slotMinutes (default 30, as in the sample CSV).
A2. All-or-nothing: if any new slot overlaps an existing slot of the same professional, no slot is created.
A3. Every slot applies at one ClinicLocation; slots imported from CSV use the default "Main Clinic".
A4. Minutes left over that do not fill a whole slot are not used (09:00–10:45 at 30 min gives 3 slots).
A5. Slots that only touch (09:00–09:30 and 09:30–10:00) do not overlap.
A6. Each professional exists once in the system, matched by name (the CSV has no licence number); overlaps are checked per professional.
